Perchance plugin · banner ad

DonationLink2Ad

A one-line, drop-in donation banner ad for any Perchance generator. Four payment chips — PayPal, Cash App, Solana (SOL) and Ethereum (ETH) — with one-click wallet-address copy. Import it, drop it in, collect tips.

01Live demo

Default theme — no options

[root.donationBanner()]

Compact · dark

[root.donationBanner({ compact: true, dark: "dark" })]

Compact · light

[root.donationBanner({ compact: true, dark: "light" })]

The banner stretches to whatever container you place it in — great as a leaderboard strip under a title, above a footer, or inside a card. On narrow screens the chips stack full-width.

02Add it to your generator

  1. In your generator's main.pjs, import the plugin (the name on the left is up to you):

  2. Drop the banner anywhere in your index.html where you want the ad to appear:

  3. Done. Visitors can tap PayPal or Cash App to donate, or tap the SOL or ETH chip to copy a wallet address to their clipboard (a small ↗ links to Solscan / Etherscan).

To point the banner at different accounts without editing this plugin, pass options per call, e.g.

03Options

OptionTypeDefaultWhat it does
namestringI am canceledName shown in the banner heading
taglinestringLiked it? …Small supporting line under the name
darkauto / light / darkautoBanner theme (auto follows the visitor's OS)
compactbooleanfalseTighter single-line layout, hides tagline
showExplorerbooleantrueShow Solscan / Etherscan links beside the SOL & ETH chips
chipsobjectall onflags chips.paypal, chips.cashApp, chips.solana, chips.eth to hide a chip
paypal.label / urlstring—PayPal button label and destination URL
cashApp.label / tag / urlstring—Cash App button label, cashtag and URL
solana.label / addressstring—SOL chip label and the wallet address to copy
solana.explorerUrlstringSolscanBlock explorer link for the wallet
solana.copyLabelstringCopy SOL addressSOL chip text before it is copied
eth.label / addressstring—ETH chip label and the EVM wallet address to copy
eth.explorerUrlstringEtherscanBlock explorer link for the wallet
eth.copyLabelstringCopy ETH addressETH chip text before it is copied

Defaults in the plugin's main.pjs are pre-filled with this page's donation targets, so zero configuration is needed — just import and place.

04Scan to donate

The same four targets as scannable QR codes — handy on a phone, or for print/social placement.
